say:1:1641101001:1.text: Many of those buried here once led extraordinary lives, but time has tucked their stories away in forgotten books and brittle scrolls.
say:1:1641101001:1.source_cn: 墓园中的长眠者们，其生前的非凡故事，多已隐入尘封的卷册内。
say:1:1641101001:1.male: Many of those buried here once led extraordinary lives, but time has tucked their stories away in forgotten books and brittle scrolls.
say:1:1641101001:1.female: Many of those buried here once led extraordinary lives, but time has tucked their stories away in forgotten books and brittle scrolls.

say:2:1641101002:1.text: Still, not everything fades into oblivion. One memory has stayed with me to this day: Fifty-seven years ago, on an early-autumn evening, as I passed the eastern section of the graveyard, second row from the gate, I saw something... unusual.
say:2:1641101002:1.source_cn: 令我至今沉淀于心的，是五十七年前秋分夜，东侧第二排一座...
say:2:1641101002:1.male: Still, not everything fades into oblivion. One memory has stayed with me to this day: Fifty-seven years ago, on an early-autumn evening, as I passed the eastern section of the graveyard, second row from the gate, I saw something... unusual.
say:2:1641101002:1.female: Still, not everything fades into oblivion. One memory has stayed with me to this day: Fifty-seven years ago, on an early-autumn evening, as I passed the eastern section of the graveyard, second row from the gate, I saw something... unusual.

say:3:1641101003:1.text: A ghost stood there, cloaked in tattered black robes, unmoving. His gaze was fixed on a name carved into the headstone: Wayne.
say:3:1641101003:1.source_cn: 一位身着褴褛黑袍的亡魂，驻足注视墓碑所刻之名——韦恩。
say:3:1641101003:1.male: A ghost stood there, cloaked in tattered black robes, unmoving. His gaze was fixed on a name carved into the headstone: Wayne.
say:3:1641101003:1.female: A ghost stood there, cloaked in tattered black robes, unmoving. His gaze was fixed on a name carved into the headstone: Wayne.

say:4:1641101004:1.text: Wayne... one of the Lyceum's most gifted mages. A legend once, until a catastrophic experiment led to his expulsion from the school.
say:4:1641101004:1.source_cn: 莱希拉姆传奇魔法师之一，曾因实验失控一度被除名。
say:4:1641101004:1.male: Wayne... one of the Lyceum's most gifted mages. A legend once, until a catastrophic experiment led to his expulsion from the school.
say:4:1641101004:1.female: Wayne... one of the Lyceum's most gifted mages. A legend once, until a catastrophic experiment led to his expulsion from the school.

say:5:1641101005:1.text: I watched him all night. He never disturbed the living or desecrated the dead. He simply traced a magic circle in the air over and over, then wiped it away before it could take form.
say:5:1641101005:1.source_cn: 我彻夜观察，亡魂未曾有惊扰活人、玷污死者的举动，仅在空...
say:5:1641101005:1.male: I watched him all night. He never disturbed the living or desecrated the dead. He simply traced a magic circle in the air over and over, then wiped it away before it could take form.
say:5:1641101005:1.female: I watched him all night. He never disturbed the living or desecrated the dead. He simply traced a magic circle in the air over and over, then wiped it away before it could take form.

say:6:1641101006:1.text: I checked the archives the next day. That spell he was trying to cast was Memory Anchoring. Wayne's own creation.
say:6:1641101006:1.source_cn: 事后我查过册籍，那法阵，的确为韦恩教授的研究成果——记...
say:6:1641101006:1.male: I checked the archives the next day. That spell he was trying to cast was Memory Anchoring. Wayne's own creation.
say:6:1641101006:1.female: I checked the archives the next day. That spell he was trying to cast was Memory Anchoring. Wayne's own creation.

say:7:1641101007:1.text: No one alive could have drawn a magic circle like that. Not even you. It had to be Professor Wayne's spirit.
say:7:1641101007:1.source_cn: 即使是你，也并不能如此熟练地勾勒此法阵。因此，那必为韦...
say:7:1641101007:1.male: No one alive could have drawn a magic circle like that. Not even you. It had to be Professor Wayne's spirit.
say:7:1641101007:1.female: No one alive could have drawn a magic circle like that. Not even you. It had to be Professor Wayne's spirit.

choice_prompt:8:1641101007.text: No one alive could have drawn a magic circle like that. Not even you. It had to be Professor Wayne's spirit.
choice_prompt:8:1641101007.source_cn: 即使是你，也并不能如此熟练地勾勒此法阵。因此，那必为韦恩教授的亡魂。
choice_prompt:8:1641101007.male: No one alive could have drawn a magic circle like that. Not even you. It had to be Professor Wayne's spirit.
choice_prompt:8:1641101007.female: No one alive could have drawn a magic circle like that. Not even you. It had to be Professor Wayne's spirit.

say:9:1641101008:1.text: No. It was a spell designed to send messages across time.
say:9:1641101008:1.source_cn: 那是一种跨越时空交流的秘术。
say:9:1641101008:1.male: No. It was a spell designed to send messages across time.
say:9:1641101008:1.female: No. It was a spell designed to send messages across time.

say:10:1641101009:1.text: Wayne first developed the spell to send a message to his son. Something went wrong. The magical backlash took the boy's life, and the school expelled him soon after.
say:10:1641101009:1.source_cn: 韦恩教授初研此术，旨在给儿子传信，却因魔法波动导致儿子...
say:10:1641101009:1.male: Wayne first developed the spell to send a message to his son. Something went wrong. The magical backlash took the boy's life, and the school expelled him soon after.
say:10:1641101009:1.female: Wayne first developed the spell to send a message to his son. Something went wrong. The magical backlash took the boy's life, and the school expelled him soon after.

say:11:1641101010:1.text: After that, he devoted the rest of his life to fixing the spell. By the time he passed away, the spell was finally safe to use.
say:11:1641101010:1.source_cn: 此后，韦恩教授倾其一生钻研此术，至临终方使其稳定安全。
say:11:1641101010:1.male: After that, he devoted the rest of his life to fixing the spell. By the time he passed away, the spell was finally safe to use.
say:11:1641101010:1.female: After that, he devoted the rest of his life to fixing the spell. By the time he passed away, the spell was finally safe to use.

say:12:1641101011:1.text: That effort earned him one last exception: a place among the dead, here in Lyceum Graveyard.
say:12:1641101011:1.source_cn: 由此，韦恩教授破例得以安葬于莱希拉姆墓园。
say:12:1641101011:1.male: That effort earned him one last exception: a place among the dead, here in Lyceum Graveyard.
say:12:1641101011:1.female: That effort earned him one last exception: a place among the dead, here in Lyceum Graveyard.

choice_prompt:13:1641101011.source_cn: 由此，韦恩教授破例得以安葬于莱希拉姆墓园。
choice_prompt:13:1641101011.male: That effort earned him one last exception: a place among the dead, here in Lyceum Graveyard.
choice_prompt:13:1641101011.female: That effort earned him one last exception: a place among the dead, here in Lyceum Graveyard.

say:14:1641101012:1.text: All night, he traced the same sentence over and over: "Leon, today's apple pie turned out perfect. The edges are crisp, just how you like them."
say:14:1641101012:1.source_cn: 我仍记得，整晚他描画的都是同一句话：莱昂，今天的苹果饼...
say:14:1641101012:1.male: All night, he traced the same sentence over and over: "Leon, today's apple pie turned out perfect. The edges are crisp, just how you like them."
say:14:1641101012:1.female: All night, he traced the same sentence over and over: "Leon, today's apple pie turned out perfect. The edges are crisp, just how you like them."

say:15:1641101013:1.text: Before he faded, he murmured one last line: "I'll come back tomorrow."
say:15:1641101013:1.source_cn: 我明天再来。这是他留下的最后话语，随即，影子便渐渐淡去。
say:15:1641101013:1.male: Before he faded, he murmured one last line: "I'll come back tomorrow."
say:15:1641101013:1.female: Before he faded, he murmured one last line: "I'll come back tomorrow."

say:16:1641101014:1.text: When I returned the next day, there was a small piece of apple pie resting by the grave.
say:16:1641101014:1.source_cn: 翌日我在墓前，发现了一小块冷却的苹果饼碎屑——
say:16:1641101014:1.male: When I returned the next day, there was a small piece of apple pie resting by the grave.
say:16:1641101014:1.female: When I returned the next day, there was a small piece of apple pie resting by the grave.

say:17:1641101015:1.text: Perfectly sweet, slightly burnt at the edge. Just like the kind students still make today.
say:17:1641101015:1.source_cn: 甜度刚好，边缘微焦，和现代学生常做的款式相似。
say:17:1641101015:1.male: Perfectly sweet, slightly burnt at the edge. Just like the kind students still make today.
say:17:1641101015:1.female: Perfectly sweet, slightly burnt at the edge. Just like the kind students still make today.

say:19:1641101016:1.text: But it's stories like these that make up the rich history of the Serene Lyceum.
say:19:1641101016:1.source_cn: 正是这些故事的积淀，铸就了莱希拉姆厚重的历史。
say:19:1641101016:1.male: But it's stories like these that make up the rich history of the Serene Lyceum.
say:19:1641101016:1.female: But it's stories like these that make up the rich history of the Serene Lyceum.

say:21:1641101017:1.text: We're on the same page there.
say:21:1641101017:1.male: We're on the same page there.
say:21:1641101017:1.female: We're on the same page there.

choice:18:1:2.text: I hope Leon knows that, wherever he is.
choice:18:1:2.male: I hope Leon knows that, wherever he is.
choice:18:1:2.female: I hope Leon knows that, wherever he is.

choice:13:0:1.text: Ghosts only linger when something keeps them from moving on.
choice:13:0:1.source_cn: 听说亡魂都有很强的执念
choice:13:0:1.male: Ghosts only linger when something keeps them from moving on.
choice:13:0:1.female: Ghosts only linger when something keeps them from moving on.

choice:13:1:2.text: He must have had something left unsaid.
choice:13:1:2.male: He must have had something left unsaid.
choice:13:1:2.female: He must have had something left unsaid.

choice:8:0:1.text: You sure he wasn't trying to summon some kind of monster?
choice:8:0:1.source_cn: 不会有怪物被召唤出来了吧？
choice:8:0:1.male: You sure he wasn't trying to summon some kind of monster?
choice:8:0:1.female: You sure he wasn't trying to summon some kind of monster?

choice:8:1:2.text: Could it have been dark magic?
choice:8:1:2.male: Could it have been dark magic?
choice:8:1:2.female: Could it have been dark magic?
